intent: Give the testsAndMisc-bash/lib directory its first test harness and cover transcribe_deps.sh (score 50, the fourth hardest-first target) plus transcribe_pkgmgr.sh alongside it. Both stay on the allowlist: 92.31% and 98.00%, below the 100% bar.
scope: .../tests/run_all.sh: new runner, deliberately WITHOUT a jail_args marker
Non-goal: the other three libs in the directory (clean_audio_filters, transcribe_venv, unity_handler) -- the harness they need now exists
Non-goal: no change to either subject; no latent bug surfaced
changes: These suites need NO jail: every branch turns on `command -v <manager>` and every install goes through sudo, both intercepted by a PATH stub dir. No jail_args file is created, so ci_mirror.sh and shell-tests.yml both run this runner bare -- verified, exit 0.

The harness REPLACES PATH rather than prepending to it. This host really has pacman, and a prepended stub dir cannot HIDE a binary, so every 'manager not installed' case would silently assert nothing. A private symlink dir supplies the coreutils the suites themselves need.

`bash` and `env` are in that dir for a non-obvious reason: every stub carries a `#!/usr/bin/env bash` shebang resolved through the restricted PATH. Without them each stub died with "env: 'bash': No such file or directory" and the branch it stood in for was silently never taken -- a failure that looked like a coverage gap.

Assertions are on RECORDED ARGV, not on the call happening: which packages a branch installs is what differs between distros (pacman gets python-virtualenv where apt gets python3-venv) and is exactly what a presence test cannot see.
ensure_cuda_runtime calls `exit 6` when cuBLAS is still missing. Called at top level that exits the SUITE, so each branch assertion runs in a subshell.

verification.evidence: test_transcribe_deps.sh: 15 passed, 0 failed; test_transcribe_pkgmgr.sh: 18 passed, 0 failed; 'All transcribe lib test files passed.' Bare runner exit=0, which is how both gates invoke it.
transcribe_deps.sh: 48/52 = 92.31%, uncovered 19, 52, 53, 55. Measured through run_all.sh, the subject is_covered() builds.
transcribe_pkgmgr.sh: 49/50 = 98.00%, uncovered 42. A second lib covered by the same harness.

The symlink exists on this host, so need_libsndfile is legitimately 0 and lines 19/52/53/55 are unreachable here. Three assertions that appeared to test this branch were REMOVED rather than left green-but-vacuous, and the limitation is written into the suite.

verification.command: shellcheck on all four new files
verification.evidence: clean; no suppressions added. A malformed `# shellcheck source=... -- comment` directive was rewritten rather than deleted.

risks: The libsndfile branch cannot be reached on a host that has the library. Covering it needs a jail that hides /usr/lib/libsndfile.so, which would mean adding a jail_args marker and making the whole directory jail-only for one branch. Deferred deliberately; the cost is 4 lines of the 52.

The restricted PATH must list every binary the suites use. A future assertion invoking an unlisted tool fails with 'command not found' rather than a clear assertion failure -- the bash/env case above cost real time to diagnose.
rollback: git revert the commit; the directory loses its harness and all five of its libs stay allowlisted with no tests.
After rollback, confirm no tests/run_all.sh remains under testsAndMisc-bash/lib, so the gate's view of the directory is unchanged.
